dsh-dracula-theme is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Dracula theme plugin for the DSH Web GUI: the classic dark palette and the Soft variant registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6a275039f7d16c5c68c4.html
